title: A Run is one seat, and a replay reaches everyone who saved one

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18: reminders, a calendar invite and a replay for every Run

detail: Owner 2026-11-18 (Journeys rework, part 5 of the #5218 split): the live sessions of a course offering are one Run, events linked to the Journey (events.journey_id) sharing details.runKey. Saving a seat for one session seats the person for every upcoming session of the same Run, members through setRsvpStatus (each sibling through the same gates, one confirmation email) and signed-out guests through capture_guest_rsvp, so the existing 7-day, 24-hour and 2-hour reminders reach every session. The event settings rail has a Replay link (details.replayUrl, https only); the hourly follow-up cron mails it once per address to everyone who saved a seat, whether or not they came, with the next session of the same course, then stamps details.replaySentAt. The BOC sessions are seeded as one Run titled as a live series.
